title: moving_average drops the last window and misses edge cases
issue_text:
statslite.moving_average(values, window) should return one simple average for every full window of `window` consecutive items, left to right.
Today it leaves out the last window: moving_average([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) returns [1.5, 2.5] where [1.5, 2.5, 3.5] is expected, and a window equal to the whole list returns [] where one value is expected.
Expected behaviour: a window larger than the data returns []; an empty list returns []; a window of 0 or a negative window raises ValueError; the input list is never modified.
Fix the bug in the repository (the code is under src/). Do not edit anything under tests/. Finish with a one-line summary.
